children: Litecoin is up 21.2% to $73.78, bringing the altcoin back to its highest level since mid-January. Trading volume has more than doubled over the past 24 hours, according to data from Coinglass, with over $2B traded in that time period. Litecoin is one of the oldest altcoins that still has an active blockchain, and enacted privacy features in 2022 similar to other privacy coins like Zcash, which has had a strong year gaining 193% year-to-date. Litecoin remains down 3% year-to-date. Bitcoin is up 0.1% to $84,307, ethereum rises 0.4% to $2,682, and XRP is up 2.4% to $1.52. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
